interface: Cells are nondegenerate affine simplices in a finite matching mesh; shape regularity bounds diameter divided by inradius.
The reference element has unisolvent degrees of freedom and defines its local nodal interpolation operator.
Conforming pieces have matching traces across interior facets; the local proof uses zero boundary nodal values for boundary traces.
For P1 with p=2, l=r=2, m=1 and l>d/p in d=2,3, the affine shape-regular cell estimate is |u-IKu|H1(K)≤C hK |u|H2(K); bounded reference nodal functionals are required.
A finite positive measure has at least m+1 points in relative support and finite moments through degree 2m−1.
Nodes are the roots of the monic orthogonal polynomial; weights are integrals of its Lagrange cardinal polynomials.
For a valid moment datum, the m-node Gauss rule integrates every polynomial of degree at most 2m−1 exactly and has positive weights.
For the moment datum, there is a unique monic degree-m polynomial orthogonal to every polynomial of degree below m.
